# Miami Elio

> Miami Elio, by Gorgona One (`https://gorgona-one.com`), is a luxury rentals, bookings, and 16-language ELIO+ Guide platform for Miami, Florida. It brings together eight verticals in one account: exotic and luxury car rentals (290+ vehicles), captained yacht charters, waterfront villas and stays, private jet charters, 74+ verified Michelin and flagship restaurants and nightlife venues, live sports and concert tickets, curated Florida experiences, and flights. Every confirmed booking is handled personally by the live Miami Elio team with ESIGN agreement, Stripe 3DS2 / PayPal Business checkout, optional Group Split-Pay, and ELIO+ Shield 100% Fulfillment & Replacement Guarantee. It is not a real estate sales site and not a retail store.

Website: https://gorgona-one.com

Many listings come from verified partners. Quotes, bookings and payments for partner-hosted listings are handled by the partner named on each page.

## Main sections

- [ELIO+ Guide — Discovery Room](https://gorgona-one.com/discovery): 16-language AI guide (ELIO) for Miami itineraries, venue comparisons, live 7-day NOAA weather planning (`KMIA`), fleet availability checks, and direct booking cards.
- [Exotic and luxury car rentals](https://gorgona-one.com/rentals): 290+ Miami supercars, luxury SUVs, convertibles, and sedans with dedicated vehicle pages, published daily rates, and airport/hotel delivery across Miami Beach, Brickell, Sunny Isles, MIA, FLL, and OPF.
- [Yacht charters](https://gorgona-one.com/yachts): Captained private yacht charters and Biscayne Bay cruises in Miami through YATR and verified Viator operators.
- [Villas and vacation rentals](https://gorgona-one.com/vacation-rentals): Luxury villas, waterfront homes, and stays across Miami Beach, Brickell, Sunny Isles Beach, and Coconut Grove.
- [Private jets](https://gorgona-one.com/private-jets): On-demand private jet charter quotes to and from Miami (`OPF`, `MIA`, `FXE`) through licensed partners PereJets (with one-way guide prices) and PrivateJetFinder.
- [Restaurants and nightlife](https://gorgona-one.com/restaurants-nightlife): 74+ verified Miami restaurants, Michelin-starred dining rooms, rooftops, beach clubs, and nightclubs with direct official links (Resy, SevenRooms, OpenTable, Tock, Discotech).
- [Event tickets](https://gorgona-one.com/events): Live Miami sports and concert tickets (NBA Miami Heat, NFL Miami Dolphins, MLS Inter Miami CF, F1 Miami Grand Prix, Miami Open, concerts) via TicketNetwork.
- [Experiences](https://gorgona-one.com/experiences): Tours, attractions, Everglades airboats, helicopter flights, and tickets across Miami and Florida via Viator and Headout.
- [Exclusive destinations](https://gorgona-one.com/exclusive-destinations): Private yachts, cruises, helicopter flights, and hand-picked VIP outings.
- [Travel and flight deals](https://gorgona-one.com/travel): Business, first-class, and Miami flight offers via Ovago.

## AI Agents & MCP Integration

- [Miami Elio MCP Server (Streamable HTTP)](https://gorgona-one.com/api/mcp): Official Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0) endpoint exposing 6 live tools: `search_luxury_cars` (290 vehicles), `check_car_availability` (live garage calendar + Split-Pay quotes), `search_miami_dining` (74+ verified venues), `search_miami_events_and_experiences`, `build_miami_itinerary`, and `submit_booking_request`.
- [MCP Discovery Manifest](https://gorgona-one.com/.well-known/mcp.json): Machine-readable MCP server card with tool list, resources, and protocol version `2025-03-26`.
